situation (example wording): "Assaults by men and women in Detroit" and "assaults against men and women in Detroit"
what the app does today: Read either way, or not read: one shadow rule read "men and women" as victims by sex wherever it appeared.
proposed behavior: "By" names the offenders: crimes by men and women are broken down by offender sex. "Against" names the victims: crimes against men and women are broken down by victim sex. The same holds for other groups ("by juveniles", "against children"). Both are answered; an offender breakdown the engine cannot compute yet is declined with that reason, never answered as victims.
why: The two give different counts of different people.
status: Decided 2026-10-29 (Jeff: "by means offenders, we will want that data too, against means victims")
test cases: shadow reading tests; new cases to write with the offender breakdowns (compiler increment 2)
